faq.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about FortexaRH
faq.notFound: Didn't find what you were looking for?
faq.supportReady: Our support team is ready to help you

1.question: How long does it take to implement FortexaRH?
1.answer: Basic implementation takes 1-3 days. It includes company setup, employee loading and initial training. For companies with more than 100 employees, the process may take 1-2 weeks.

2.question: Does FortexaRH comply with Dominican regulations (TSS, DGII)?
2.answer: Yes, FortexaRH is 100% adapted to Dominican labor law. We automatically calculate ISR, AFP, SFS according to current tables and generate the required official formats.

3.question: Can I migrate data from Excel or another system?
3.answer: Absolutely. We offer bulk import from Excel and CSV. Our support team assists you through the entire migration process at no additional cost.

4.question: How secure is my employees' information?
4.answer: We use AES-256 encryption for data at rest and TLS 1.3 for data in transit. Our servers are on AWS with SOC 2 certification.

5.question: Can I try the system before paying?
5.answer: Yes, we offer a 14-day free trial with full access. No credit card required and you can cancel anytime.

6.question: What technical support is included?
6.answer: All plans include email and chat support. Pro and Enterprise plans include phone support and a dedicated account manager.

7.question: Does it integrate with biometric attendance systems?
7.answer: Yes, we integrate with major biometric devices on the market. We also support mobile app check-in with geolocation.

8.question: How many users can access the system?
8.answer: We don't limit the number of admin users. Pricing is based on active employees, not system users.

payroll-create.title: Create a payroll period
payroll-create.body: Go to Payroll > New Period. Select the month, year and type (biweekly/monthly). The system will automatically calculate salaries, TSS deductions, ISR and AFP for all active employees.

payroll-approve.title: Payroll approval workflow
payroll-approve.body: Once created, the period must be submitted for approval. An approver can approve or reject. Approving makes payslips ready for payment. Rejecting returns to draft with comments.

payroll-pay.title: Process payroll payment
payroll-pay.body: After approval, click 'Mark as Paid'. Each employee receives a push notification in their portal with their payslip available. Payslips are automatically generated as PDF.

payroll-export.title: Export compliance reports
payroll-export.body: Generate TSS, DGII and ISR reports from the Reports section. You can export in Excel or PDF format for Dominican Republic regulatory authorities.

vacation-request.title: Request vacation
vacation-request.body: Employees can request vacation from their portal, or an administrator can create them. Select the leave type, dates and add an optional reason.

vacation-approve.title: Approve or reject requests
vacation-approve.body: Pending requests appear in the dashboard. When approved or rejected, the employee receives an instant push notification in their browser and an in-app notification.

vacation-policy.title: Configure vacation policy
vacation-policy.body: Define available days per year of service, accrual policy, maximum day cap and special rules according to Dominican legislation.

leave-types.title: Leave types
leave-types.body: The system supports: Vacation, Maternity/Paternity Leave, Medical Leave, Personal Leave, Bereavement, and custom leave types.

employee-add.title: Add a new employee
employee-add.body: Go to Employees > New. Fill in personal data, ID number, position, department, salary and hire date. The employee will automatically receive access to the self-service portal.

employee-portal.title: Employee Self-Service Portal
employee-portal.body: Employees log in with their ID number and password. They can view payslips, request vacation, record attendance, view evaluations and manage their notifications.

org-chart.title: Company org chart
org-chart.body: Visualize your company's organizational structure. Drag and drop employees to reorganize departments and reporting lines.

employee-docs.title: Documents and contracts
employee-docs.body: Generate employment contracts, work letters and other documents from the employee profile. Supports electronic signatures for validation.

notif-config.title: Configure notification preferences
notif-config.body: Go to Settings > Notifications. Enable or disable channels (In-App, Email, Push) for each of the 20 event types. Customize what alerts you receive and how.

notif-push.title: Enable Push notifications
notif-push.body: Push notifications alert you even when the app is not open. Toggle 'Push Notifications' on and accept the browser permission. Works on Chrome, Edge and Firefox.

notif-center.title: Employee Notification Center
notif-center.body: Employees have a dedicated 'Notifications' tab in their portal with search, category filter, mark as read and export history to CSV.

notif-quiet.title: Quiet hours and Digest
notif-quiet.body: Set quiet hours to pause push/email during nights or weekends. Enable Digest to receive a daily or weekly summary instead of individual emails.

attendance-checkin.title: Record check-in and check-out
attendance-checkin.body: Employees record their entry and exit from the portal. The system automatically calculates hours worked, overtime and tardiness.

attendance-geo.title: Geolocation attendance
attendance-geo.body: Configure allowed zones for attendance. The system validates the employee is at the authorized location when recording check-in/out.

attendance-report.title: Attendance reports
attendance-report.body: Generate reports by employee, department or period. Includes hours worked, tardiness, absences and overtime.

eval-create.title: Create performance evaluations
eval-create.body: Schedule evaluations for individual employees or groups. Define criteria, rating scales and measurable objectives.

eval-templates.title: Evaluation templates
eval-templates.body: Create reusable templates with predefined criteria. Save time when evaluating multiple employees with the same parameters.

partner-dashboard.title: Partner Dashboard
partner-dashboard.body: View KPIs of your referred clients: recurring revenue, pending commissions, processed payouts and growth metrics.

partner-clients.title: Manage referred clients
partner-clients.body: Add new clients from your panel. Each client who registers through your link automatically generates commissions on their subscription.

partner-payouts.title: Request commission payouts
partner-payouts.body: Request payouts via PayPal or Stripe when your balance reaches the minimum. Payments are processed within 24-48 business hours.

settings-company.title: Configure company settings
settings-company.body: Customize name, logo, brand colors, address and tax info (RNC). This data appears on generated documents and the portal.

settings-2fa.title: Enable two-factor authentication
settings-2fa.body: Add an extra security layer. Scan the QR code with Google Authenticator or Authy. Save your recovery codes in a safe place.

settings-language.title: Change system language
settings-language.body: FortexaRH is available in Spanish, English and French. Change the language from the language selector (globe icon) in the top bar.

settings-integrations.title: Available integrations
settings-integrations.body: Connect with Stripe and PayPal for payments, QuickBooks for accounting, and enable Google Auth for social login. Enterprise integrations (SAP, Oracle) are available on the Enterprise plan.

reports-center.title: Report Center
reports-center.body: Advanced filters by date, department and type. Export to Excel and PDF.

reports-dgii.title: DGII-TSS Reports
reports-dgii.body: Generate and download DGII reports: IR-3, IR-4, IR-17, IR-6 and TSS. Includes employee breakdown.

reports-advanced.title: Advanced Reports
reports-advanced.body: Comparative charts, payroll trends, turnover analysis and department costs.

calc-basic.title: Basic Payroll Calculator
calc-basic.body: Enter base salary to get net salary with TSS deductions (SFS 3.04%, AFP 2.87%) and ISR.

calc-deductions.title: TSS and ISR Deductions
calc-deductions.body: Automatic calculation: SFS 3.04%, AFP 2.87% and ISR per DGII table.

calc-edit.title: Edit ISR Manually
calc-edit.body: Click on Monthly ISR to edit. Total deductions and net salary recalculate automatically.

docs-templates.title: Document Templates
docs-templates.body: Create templates for contracts, letters and certifications with dynamic variables.

docs-generate.title: Generate Documents
docs-generate.body: Select a template and employee to auto-generate PDF documents.

docs-employee.title: Employee File
docs-employee.body: Digital file with contracts, IDs, evaluations and pay stubs.

accounting-overview.title: General Accounting
accounting-overview.body: Auto-generated journal entries for each payroll period.

accounting-quickbooks.title: QuickBooks Online
accounting-quickbooks.body: Sync payroll with 8-account mapping and one-click consolidated journal entries.

accounting-payments.title: Payments & Billing
accounting-payments.body: Stripe and PayPal subscription payments and billing history.

update-isr-editable.title: Editable ISR in Calculator and Payroll Sheet
update-isr-editable.body: Edit ISR values directly in calculator results and payroll sheet. Net salary recalculates automatically.

update-sfs-afp-editable.title: Editable SFS, AFP and Overtime
update-sfs-afp-editable.body: SFS, AFP and Overtime columns in payroll sheet are now editable.

update-qb-journal.title: Journal Entries to QuickBooks
update-qb-journal.body: Send consolidated payroll journal entries to QuickBooks Online with one click.

update-dgii-fix.title: DGII Reports Fix
update-dgii-fix.body: Fixed download and employee breakdown errors in all DGII report formats.

update-sfs-rate.title: SFS Rate Correction to 3.04%
update-sfs-rate.body: Corrected SFS percentage from 3.07% to 3.04% across the entire system.

update-qb-mapping.title: QuickBooks Account Mapping
update-qb-mapping.body: New account mapping section in Settings > Integrations for QuickBooks sync.

update-push-auto.title: Automatic Push for Payroll and Vacations
update-push-auto.body: Employees receive automatic push notifications when payroll is processed or vacation requests are approved/rejected.

update-notif-center.title: Employee Notification Center
update-notif-center.body: Notifications tab in employee portal with search, category filter, mark all as read and CSV export.

update-error-std.title: Standardized API Error Responses
update-error-std.body: All API endpoints return errors in standardized format with consistent codes and messages.

update-push-pwa.title: PWA Push Notifications
update-push-pwa.body: Full push notification support via service worker. Employees can enable push from their portal.

faq-reset-password.q: How do I reset my password?
faq-reset-password.a: On the login screen, click 'Forgot your password?'. Enter your email and you'll receive a link to create a new password. If you have 2FA enabled, you'll also need your verification code.

faq-portal-access.q: How does an employee access their portal?
faq-portal-access.a: Employees access from /employee-portal using their ID number as username. The first time, the password is their ID number. It's recommended to change it immediately.

faq-push-enable.q: How do I enable push notifications?
faq-push-enable.a: Go to Settings > Notifications and toggle Push Notifications on. Your browser will ask for permission. In the employee portal, the notification bell has a built-in push toggle.

faq-export-data.q: How do I export data from the system?
faq-export-data.a: Each module has export options. Payroll: export TSS/DGII reports in Excel. Employees: export list in CSV. Notifications: use the 'Export CSV' button in the Notification Center.

faq-language-change.q: How do I change the system language?
faq-language-change.a: Click the globe icon in the top bar and select Spanish, English or French. The change is immediate and applies to the entire system, including notifications.

faq-vacation-balance.q: How do I see my available vacation days?
faq-vacation-balance.a: In the employee portal, the 'Available Vacations' card shows your current balance. You can also see the full breakdown in the Vacations tab: accrued, used and available days.

faq-payslip-view.q: Where do I view my payslips?
faq-payslip-view.a: In the employee portal, go to the 'Payslips' tab. You'll find all your payslips sorted by date. You can view details and download as PDF.

faq-2fa-setup.q: How do I set up two-factor authentication?
faq-2fa-setup.a: Go to Settings > Security > Enable 2FA. Scan the QR code with an app like Google Authenticator or Authy. Save the generated recovery codes - they're your only way to access if you lose your device.

faq-partner-join.q: How do I become a FortexaRH Partner?
faq-partner-join.a: Contact us through the form at /soporte selecting 'Enterprise Plan' category or email us at info@fortexarh.com. We'll send you the partner program and commission details.

faq-quiet-hours.a: Quiet Hours let you pause push and email notifications during specific times (e.g., 10pm to 7am). In-app notifications continue to accumulate for you to check when you want. Configure them in Notifications > Schedule.

faq-edit-isr.q: How do I edit ISR in the calculator or payroll sheet?
faq-edit-isr.a: In the calculator, click on the Monthly ISR value to edit it. In the Payroll Sheet, click any ISR, SFS, AFP or Overtime cell to modify the value. The system recalculates net salary automatically.

faq-qb-connect.q: How do I connect QuickBooks Online?
faq-qb-connect.a: Go to Settings > Integrations and click Connect next to QuickBooks Online. Authorize with your Intuit account, then configure account mapping to send payroll journal entries.

faq-dgii-reports.q: How do I download DGII reports?
faq-dgii-reports.a: Go to DGII-TSS Reports, select the payroll period and click the download button for the desired report (IR-3, IR-4, IR-17, IR-6 or TSS). You can also view the employee breakdown before downloading.
